comics.title: Fran Hopper Comics
comics.description: Golden Age comics by pioneering artist Fran Hopper (1922-2017), featuring strong female protagonists in space adventure and science fiction stories.

storylines.title: Gale Allen and the Girl Squadron
storylines.description: Captain Gale Allen leads her all-female space battalion through thrilling adventures across the galaxy. From Planet Comics #30-40 (1944-1945).

pages.title: Gale Allen, Page 1
pages.alt: Title splash page showing Gale Allen struggling with a villain near the shore of Cardor as Tatlan rocket ships invade.
pages.transcript:
### SPLASH PANEL

_Title: GALE ALLEN and the GIRL SQUADRON by Douglas McKee_

_Gale Allen, a blonde woman in a blue uniform, struggles against a muscular villain wearing a feathered headdress. They stand on a platform near the shore, with futuristic buildings and water in the background._

### PANEL 1

_Rocket ships descend over a coastal city._

> _[NARRATION]: One morning, the people of Cardor are aroused by the thunder of invading rocket ships._

### PANEL 2

_Citizens look up in alarm at the attacking ships._

**CITIZEN 1:** To arms! They're Tatlans, man the guns!

**CITIZEN 2:** Ohhh...

### PANEL 3

_Close-up of the villain's face, a cruel sneer on his lips._

**TATLAN CONQUEROR:** Cardorians... you will resist no more. From now on you will obey my commands. The gas has made you slaves!
pages.commentary: This title page establishes the central conflict: the Tatlans have invaded Cardor using mind-control gas. Fran Hopper's dynamic composition puts Gale Allen front and center, establishing her as the hero who will oppose this threat.
pages.excerpt: The Tatlans invade Cardor with mind-control gas, enslaving the population.

pages.title: Gale Allen, Page 2
pages.alt: On Venus, Gale Allen receives news of the Tatlan invasion and prepares to lead a rescue mission.
pages.transcript:
### PANEL 1

_On Venus. A group watches a television transmission showing the invasion._

**CAPTION:** ...But on Venus...

**OFFICER:** Television message coming in from Cardor. That's a queer mist creeping toward him...

**GALE ALLEN:** Tatlanians attacking with gas. People have lost their minds... gas permeating this room now... Ohhh!

### PANEL 2

_Gale Allen addresses her superiors._

**GALE ALLEN:** That's all I saw, gentlemen! We must help!

**COMMANDER:** True, Gale. Assemble your squadron! I'll have an antidote sent to the field!

### PANEL 3

_Loading dock. Squadron members carry supplies._

**OFFICER:** Take stations, girls! We're loading the ships now!

### PANEL 4

_Gale Allen hides a container in her locker._

**GALE ALLEN:** I'll stow away a container of the antidote in this locker. One can never tell what's going to happen!

### PANEL 5

_The Girl Squadron's ship rockets through space._

**CAPTION:** Soon, the ship skims into space toward Tatlan...

### PANEL 6

_Inside an enemy vessel, the Tatlan conqueror watches._

**CAPTION:** But on an unseen spaceship nearby...

**TATLAN CONQUEROR:** So... the Venusians are going to try... to help their friends. Fire gas rocket number one!
pages.commentary: This page showcases the rapid pacing of Golden Age comics — within six panels we go from learning about the crisis to launching a rescue mission to the enemy's counter-attack.
pages.excerpt: Gale Allen and the Girl Squadron launch a rescue mission from Venus.

pages.title: Gale Allen, Page 3
pages.alt: The Girl Squadron is attacked but Gale Allen has a plan — they will pretend to be under the gas's influence.
pages.transcript:
### PANEL 1

_Inside the spacecraft, alarms blare._

**SQUADRON MEMBER:** Tatlans attacking! They've hit our supply ship! Got to warn them!

### PANEL 2

_Gale Allen speaks into the communicator._

**GALE ALLEN:** Commander Allen to supply ship. That was a gas rocket! Take injections of antidote immediately!

### PANEL 3

_Another squadron member urges haste._

**SQUADRON MEMBER:** They're shelling us! Hurry... use the hypo I gave you.

### PANEL 4

_Gale speaks into the radio, outlining her plan._

**GALE ALLEN:** Commander to freighter... Listen carefully! First behave erratically, then follow whatever Tatlan instructions come over the inter-com. I will advise next step as soon as we land!

### PANEL 5

_The Tatlan conqueror gloats aboard his vessel._

**CAPTION:** Soon, the conqueror speaks...

**TATLAN CONQUEROR:** You are now my slaves! Follow us to Tatlan! Full speed ahead!

### PANEL 6

_Gale and her squadron walk as prisoners, space miles later._

**CAPTION:** Space miles later...

**GALE ALLEN:** _(thinking)_ Have to be careful. They don't get wise!
pages.commentary: Gale Allen's quick thinking turns a setback into an opportunity. Rather than fight a losing battle, she has her squadron feign being gassed — classic infiltration tactics.
pages.excerpt: The squadron pretends to be gassed to infiltrate Tatlan territory.

pages.title: Gale Allen, Page 4
pages.alt: On Tatlan, the Girl Squadron works as slaves while secretly administering the antidote and learning the location of the gas factory.
pages.transcript:
### PANEL 1

_A guard directs the captured squadron._

**GUARD:** Drive them to the fields and put them to work!

### PANEL 2

_Gale Allen and her squadron march, pretending to be under mind control._

**GALE ALLEN:** _(thinking)_ They haven't taken our ray guns. No doubt they think now we're under their control... and our weapons are unimportant!

### PANEL 3

_A scenic view shows a pyramid structure with palm trees._

**CAPTION:** Soon.

### PANEL 4

_A guard forces a man to take an injection._

**GUARD:** Here, slave, innoculate yourself with this... that's right.

### PANEL 5

_A man awakens from the gas's influence, confused._

**CARDORIAN MAN:** What!.. Where am I? What am I doing? I belong on Cardor!

### PANEL 6

_Gale quietly speaks to the awakened man._

**GALE ALLEN:** Shh. You've been drugged. Keep up the pretense... do you know where the gas is made?

**CARDORIAN MAN:** Yes, yes... inside the pyramid!
pages.commentary: The stakes become clear: the Girl Squadron must not only free themselves but also liberate the enslaved people of Cardor. The pyramid housing the gas factory is the key target.
pages.excerpt: Working as slaves, Gale secretly administers the antidote and locates the gas factory.

pages.title: Gale Allen, Page 5
pages.alt: Gale Allen plans to destroy the gas factory while the freed workers prepare to attack the guards.
pages.transcript:
### PANEL 1

_Gale Allen looks at the pyramid, formulating her plan._

**GALE ALLEN:** If I can drop my ray gun shells down that shaft, it would blow up the entire plant.

### PANEL 2

_The squadron has been administering the antidote._

**GALE ALLEN:** My girls have administered the antidote to the others. Now we are ready!

### PANEL 3

_The freed workers slowly position themselves near the guards._

**CAPTION:** Slowly, the workers edge toward the guards...

### PANEL 4

_The attack begins! Gale breaks away toward the pyramid._

**CAPTION:** Suddenly...

**GALE ALLEN:** The attack has started!.. I'll destroy... the gas chamber.

### PANEL 5

_Gale runs up the side of the pyramid._

**GALE ALLEN:** Once I make the side, they won't be able to catch me!
pages.commentary: The action reaches its climax with a coordinated two-pronged assault: the freed prisoners attacking the guards while Gale races to destroy the gas factory. Hopper's use of diagonal panels creates dynamic movement.
pages.excerpt: The freed prisoners attack while Gale races to destroy the gas chamber.

storylines.title: Mysta of the Moon
storylines.description: Mysta, a brilliant scientist with advanced knowledge, defends Earth from cosmic threats from her lunar base. From Planet Comics #37-49 (1945-1947).

pages.title: Mysta of the Moon, Page 1
pages.alt: Title splash showing Mysta watering rows of men growing from the ground like plants on Planet Ares.
pages.transcript:
### SPLASH PANEL

_Title: MYSTA of the MOON by Ross Gallun_

_Mysta, a beautiful woman in a red outfit, stands with a hose, watering rows of men who are growing out of the ground like plants. Their arms reach upward, faces contorted in agony._

> _[NARRATION]: Only the madness of a warped genius could conceive such a plan... diabolically clever, it would destroy the universe! But there was Mysta, whose mind was schooled to peace and culture and freedom... whose mind was filled with all knowledge. Could she stop the coming debacle?_

### PANEL 1

_Mysta observes through her enlarger lens._

**MYSTA:** Hmm... what's all the commotion on the planet Ares?

### PANEL 2

_Mysta sees an alarming sight through her viewer — rows of armed men marching._

**MYSTA:** That does it! My enlarger lens shows... No! It can't be! But it is!
pages.commentary: This disturbing splash page introduces the villain Gor, who literally grows soldiers like crops. Hopper's grotesque imagery makes the threat visceral and immediate.
pages.excerpt: Mysta discovers Gor's horrifying man-plant army on Planet Ares.

pages.title: Mysta of the Moon, Page 2
pages.alt: Mysta's robot attacks Gor's compound, tearing down barbed wire and electrocuting guards.
pages.transcript:
### PANEL 1

_The robot charges forward, destroying barriers._

> _[NARRATION]: Receiving Mysta's thought-order, the robot clicks into motion... collapsing time via seven-league strides..._

### PANEL 2

_The robot tears through electrified defenses._

> _[NARRATION]: He tears down barbed wires with his super-charged metal hands..._

### PANEL 3

_Guards collapse from electric shocks._

> _[NARRATION]: Radiating electrocuting shocks to wither Gor's guards dead in their tracks!_

### PANEL 4

_The robot comes to Mysta's aid._

> _[NARRATION]: ...and on to the aid of his mistress..._

### PANEL 5

_Gor cries out as the robot smashes the glass enclosure._

**GOR:** Stop him! He's smashed the chemo-glass walls! My man-plants will die from unfiltered light!

### PANEL 6

_The robot grabs Gor._

**GOR:** Let the girl go, you oaf! Seal the roof! My plants are withering!

**MYSTA:** Pick him up, robot — and toss him!

**SFX:** EEEAA...
pages.commentary: The robot's rescue mission is depicted with dynamic action across multiple panels, showcasing Hopper's skill at conveying movement and impact.
pages.excerpt: Mysta's robot storms Gor's compound and defeats the villain.

pages.title: Mysta of the Moon, Page 3
pages.alt: Planet Comics #38 cover featuring Mysta battling dinosaur-like creatures in an arena.
pages.transcript:
### COVER

_Planet Comics No. 38, September, 10¢_

_"Weird Adventures on Other Worlds — The Universe of the Future"_

_Featured: "The newest THRILL-FEATURE! MYSTA of the MOON"_

_Also: LOST WORLD, STAR PIRATE, SPACE RANGERS — and many others_

_Mysta, a blonde woman in an orange outfit with jetpack, fires a ray gun at purple dinosaur-like creatures in what appears to be an arena setting. A crowd watches from the stands as the beasts rear up. A woman in red is being menaced by one of the creatures._
pages.commentary: This dynamic cover by Fran Hopper showcases Mysta in action — jetpack, ray gun, and all. The arena setting and alien creatures typify the pulp sci-fi aesthetic of Planet Comics.
pages.excerpt: Cover: Mysta battles alien creatures in a futuristic arena.

pages.title: Mysta of the Moon, Page 4
pages.alt: Title splash showing Mysta flying through space above planets, with panels about her knowledge discs and the slimy horde threat.
pages.transcript:
### SPLASH PANEL

_Title: MYSTA of the MOON by Ross Gallun_

_Mysta soars through space in a flowing silver gown, arms outstretched. Planets and moons surround her against the cosmic backdrop._

> _[NARRATION]: Trained from infancy by science, all knowledge was hers. Yet was it enough to combat the slimy horde threatening to envelop the universe — those creatures of nothing... yet everything?_

### PANEL 1

_Mysta works with her robot in a laboratory filled with scientific equipment._

**MYSTA:** Fine time for a robot to break down. Just when I need you to crate my knowledge discs for the professors!

### PANEL 2

_Mysta looks concerned._

**MYSTA:** My discs record all knowledge and culture in the universe... the professors can spread learning all over. Oh, my neo-screen buzzer!

### PANEL 3

_On a video screen, an older bearded man speaks._

**PROFESSOR KAR:** Professor Kar... Doctor Lane... you're leaving now? Take the Saturn-Jupiter short cut!

**PROFESSOR:** We will, Mysta.
pages.commentary: This splash page establishes Mysta's role as guardian of universal knowledge. The 'slimy horde' teaser creates cosmic-scale stakes typical of Planet Comics storytelling.
pages.excerpt: Mysta prepares her knowledge discs as a new threat looms.

pages.title: Mysta of the Moon, Page 5
pages.alt: Planet Comics #39 cover showing a mysterious woman caught in giant death-webs at Zenith.
pages.transcript:
### COVER

_Planet Comics No. 39, November, 10¢_

_"Death-Webs at Zenith!"_

_Featuring MYSTA of the MOON_

_Also STAR PIRATE — SPACE RANGERS and many others_

_A striking woman with dark hair, wearing a dark green/black swimsuit, is caught in an enormous golden spider web. Her arms are spread wide as she struggles against the strands. In a circular inset at the bottom, a man and woman in futuristic clothing stand inside a protective bubble, the man aiming a weapon._
pages.commentary: This cover depicts the 'Death-Webs at Zenith' storyline. The trapped figure's dramatic pose and the cosmic web create an iconic Golden Age cover image. Note the inset showing heroes preparing to rescue her.
pages.excerpt: Cover: Death-Webs at Zenith threatens our heroes.
